newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico sees value of 1997 trade with U.S up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico sees value of 1997 trade with U.S up 10 pct.

text.p: Trade between Mexico and the United States should rise by 10 percent in 1997 to $160 billion, the Mexican commerce secretary said on Monday.
"Bilateral trade between Mexico and the United States will increase by 10 percent this year to $160 billion, compared to more than $145 billion in 1997," the ministry said in a statement.
It added that Mexico's overall trade was worth $102.491 billion in the first six months of the year. Trade with the United States constitutes the bulk of Mexico's exports and imports.
The ministry said the upcoming implementation of an accord on basic telecommunications through the World Trade Organization should further boost trade.
Mexico was the 10th largest exporter in the world in 1996, the ministry said.
